title: The Coverage Selection Gap: Ranking, Not Generation, Limits LLM Rubric Construction
abstract: arXiv:2611.25557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task-specific rubrics are increasingly used to evaluate open-ended language-model outputs, yet constructing comprehensive evaluation criteria from complex source documents remains challenging. We study automatic rubric construction in professional mergers and acquisitions (M&A) due diligence, where evaluation criteria must be inferred from task instructions and supporting documents without access to an expert-authored reference rubric. We introduce a multi-axis generation framework that explores complementary structural and free-form views of the source evidence to construct a broad pool of candidate evaluation criteria. To distinguish failures of criterion discovery from failures of candidate selection, we introduce the coverage-selection gap, which measures the difference between reference-free ranking and a reference-informed greedy diagnostic under a fixed selection budget. Developed on 16 tasks and evaluated on four held-out tasks

translated_title: 覆盖-选择差距：限制LLM评分标准构建的是排序而非生成
translated_abstract: 任务特定的评分标准正被越来越多地用于评估开放式的语言模型输出，然而从复杂的源文档中构建全面的评估标准仍然具有挑战性。我们研究了专业并购尽调场景中的自动评分标准构建问题，在该场景下，评估标准必须从任务指令和支持文档中推断得出，而无法获取专家撰写的参考评分标准。我们引入了一个多轴生成框架，该框架从互补的结构化和自由形式视角探索源证据，以构建一个广泛的候选评估标准池。为了区分评估标准发现的失败与候选选择的失败，我们提出了“覆盖-选择差距”这一概念，用于衡量在固定选择预算下，无参考排序方法与基于参考的贪婪诊断方法之间的性能差异。该方法在16个任务上开发，并在4个留出任务上进行评估。
tldr: 该论文发现在自动评分标准构建中，限制性能的瓶颈是对候选标准的排序选择而非标准生成，并提出“覆盖-选择差距”指标来量化无参考排序与有参考贪婪诊断之间的性能差异。
en_tdlr: The paper identifies that ranking, rather than generation, is the bottleneck limiting LLM rubric construction, and introduces the "coverage-selection gap" metric to quantify the performance difference between reference-free ranking and reference-informed greedy diagnostic selection under a fixed selection budget.
